name: repos
title: Repositories
summary: Git repositories in the drive: clone, pull and push over HTTPS with personal git credentials, browse and edit code in the app, branches with protection, and pull requests with line comments, reviews and merges; agents work through branch → commit → pull request.

env.name: REPOS_DIR
env.doc: Directory holding the bare git repositories. Production: a persistent volume mounted on the one instance that serves /git and repository writes.

env.name: REPOS_GIT_BIN
env.doc: The git executable (2.38 or newer). Checked at boot; too old or missing fails the boot outside development.

env.name: REPOS_MAX_PUSH_BYTES
env.doc: Largest push (request body and pack) in bytes; also the largest folder turned into a repository.

env.name: REPOS_MAX_EDIT_BYTES
env.doc: Largest file shown and edited in the browser, in bytes (64 KB to 16 MB).

env.name: REPOS_MAX_COMMIT_BYTES
env.doc: Largest in-browser commit (edits and uploads together), in bytes.

env.name: REPOS_GIT_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Time limit for each git process the API runs (reads, commits, merges).

env.name: REPOS_HTTP_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Time limit for one clone, fetch or push over HTTPS.

stitch: Mount REPOS_DIR on a persistent volume and run one instance for /git and repository writes (repositories live on that disk); install git 2.38+ in the image.
